raised: The page names alternatives but never shows side by side what each would give, so unsure which product to pick
The '123 מקמן / חושב / הזנה' row is confusing; doesn't know what מקמן means
The basic and extended package descriptions give no prices
Codes BANK-20, BANK-23, BANK-15 (and TXI OQ11, BANK OQ9) mean nothing
'כמה זה עולה' doesn't say how much the fee is, only refers to the bank's price list
Red box: unclear whether the low-income tax exemption applies; the site doesn't apply it, which worried them
No deposit insurance, and government help is discretionary; frightening
Age-based exemptions apply to them at 61 but the site doesn't calculate them
'ההפקדות שלכם' shows 62,681 instead of 70,000, with no label next to the number saying it's in today's money
Calculator assumes a 5% return for an account that often pays no interest, so they lost trust; should start at 0%
Pink tax line and orange fees line are too thin to see on the graph
The age field doesn't say what changes at the marked ages
Cost table's rules column is empty and ceiling column just refers to the price list
Doesn't understand 'הטבה בנקאית'
Couldn't find what interest banks actually pay on current accounts today
Couldn't find how much to keep in the current account and how much to move
Couldn't find whether a money-market fund is safe
Would drop the 'מונחים' terms table
Would drop 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' (except the age line)
Would drop 'מי מציע ומי מפקח'
Would drop the future-shekels toggle and the inflation and age fields

problems.why: The reader had 'today's money' selected and ignored the future-shekels option; their deposits complaint is about a missing label, not about future-shekel figures ignoring inflation, and dropping the toggle isn't the same as saying it's wrong.

raised: The row '123 מקמן / 123 חושב / 123 הזנה' is confusing; the reader doesn't know what מקמן means
The basic and extended packages in 'מה זה' come with no prices
Codes like BANK-20, BANK-23 and BANK-15 mean nothing to the reader
'כמה זה עולה' doesn't say how much the fixed account fee is; it only points to the bank's price list
The red box says it's unknown whether the low-income tax exemption applies; this worried the reader and didn't help
The risks section is frightening: there's no deposit insurance, government help is discretionary, and the 250,000 ₪ protection is only a proposal
The site doesn't calculate age-based exemptions, which is exactly the reader's situation at 61
'Your deposits' shows 62,681 instead of 70,000, with no label next to it saying this is in today's money
The calculator assumes a 5% return for an account that often pays nothing, so it should start at 0%
The pink tax line and orange fees line in the graph are too thin to see
The age field doesn't say what changes at the marked ages
In the cost table the ceiling column only points to the price list and the rules column is empty
The reader doesn't understand what 'הטבה בנקאית' is or whether to ask the bank for it
No typical range is given for the monthly bank charge in shekels
No range is given for the interest banks actually pay on current accounts today
There's no side-by-side figure comparing a current account, a money-market fund and a fixed deposit after tax and fees
No guidance on how much to keep in the current account and how much to move
The page doesn't say whether a money-market fund is safe without deposit insurance
The reader would drop the 'מונחים' glossary table
The reader would drop 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' (except the age line) and 'מי מציע ומי מפקח'
The reader would drop the future-shekels toggle and the inflation and age fields

problems.why: The reader had today's money selected and ignored the future-shekels option; no item says the future-shekels figures wrongly ignore inflation (item 8 is about a missing label in today's-money mode, and item 21 only wants the toggle dropped).
